intended_object: The unique morphism of fans from any fan Σ in N_ℝ to the fan of a point, i.e. the zero cone {0} in the zero lattice. It is induced by the zero lattice map N → 0, and on toric varieties it gives the structure morphism X_Σ → Spec k. The source is the docstring and the module doc.
explanation: `pointFan` is the fan on the lattice `Fin 0 → ℤ` (the zero lattice) whose only cone is the zero cone `⊥`. `Fan.toPoint` uses `FanHom.ofLatticeMap` with lattice map `0`, so its real-linear part is the scalar extension of `0`, which is again `0`. The compatibility condition holds because every cone maps into `⊥`. The proof uses that `PointedCone ℝ (Fin 0 → ℝ)` is a subsingleton. This is the standard morphism to the fan of a point (the terminal object), and the library proves it is unique (`FanHom.eq_toPoint`). It is stated for an arbitrary fan Φ, so it is fully general. Mathlib has no theory of fans, so there is no counterpart there.
